[[File:Infinity Castle.png|thumb|275x275px|<span style="font-size:200%;">Muzo</span><br><span style="color: #9e0000; font-size:125%;"><i>"I am an eternal creature infinitely close to perfection."</i>]]

The '''Infinity Mansion''', introduced in [[Update_Log#Update_6_-_Jujutsu_Kaisen_Update_Part_1|Update 6]] as '''Infinity Castle,''' is a mode where the player is challenged with a series of seemingly infinite rooms. It's '''EXTREMELY''' tedious, but the rewards are worth your while!

==Information==
* As of Update 18, for the first 63 rooms in the Mansion, the player is tasked with beating 3 acts of each story all the way up until Rain village gaining 150 gems for each floor.
:* After the 57th room, the Mansion becomes unpredictable, however the next three floors after the 57th room will have higher HP before nerfing down at the 60th room onwards, so be careful!
* Starting Season 2, on Floors 100 and higher, [[Damage Affinities / Elements|resistances]] show up, the further you go the stronger those values are.
* To access the Mansion, talk to the Muzo NPC by spawn. After heading inside, the Nakimo NPC will let you challenge the Mansion!
* From this season 9, you can change the mode to hard, it will clear 2 rooms, but the stage will be harder! However, after the 100th room, the mode is always set to hard, but you do not clear 2 rooms at once getting 300 gems instead of 150.

==Trivia==
* As of Update 16...
** Developers added Hard mode for which makes you skip 2 rooms instead of 1 (until Floor 100).
** They even added [[Raids|Raid]]-exclusive maps and [[Events|Event]]-exclusive maps into the mix. 
** On room 50 onwards damage types are added to enemies.
